blocks.html: Send an emergency beacon to everyone on the network so they see your position and the type of trouble you are in.

slides.title: Open the Alert Tool
slides.html: Tap the Alert icon (warning triangle) to open the Alert Tool. It puts an emergency beacon at your location on the map.

slides.title: Pick the emergency type
slides.html:
Open the Select the type of emergency drop-down and choose one:

  • 911 Alert — need assistance now
  • Ring The Bell — call attention to your position
  • Geo-fence Breached — a boundary was crossed
  • In Contact — engaged with the enemy

slides.title: Enable both switches to broadcast
slides.html: After picking the type, flip both LOCKED switches on. The TAK Server then broadcasts your beacon to every network contact. The beacon keeps broadcasting even if your device is turned off.

slides.title: Cancel the beacon
slides.html: To stand down, return to the Alert tool and toggle both switches off. This cancels the beacon and removes it from the map.
